# brig update

Change a VM's resources, mounts, network profile or OpenShell config directories

## Synopsis

```text
brig update [NAME]
```

## Description

Change a VM's settings.

On a running VM, mounts change at once, and --add-openshell-config and
--remove-openshell-config take effect with [`brig sync`](brig-sync.md) NAME. CPUs, memory, the
network profile and the space on grown disks change when the VM next starts.
A sandbox mount cannot be removed from a running VM while a sandbox uses its
volume.

## Options

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--add-mount stringArray` | add a mount: SOURCE[:TARGET][:OPTIONS] as for brig create --mount (repeatable) |
| `--add-openshell-config stringArray` | add an OpenShell config directory (repeatable) |
| `--cpus int` | number of virtual CPUs |
| `--data-disk size` | grow the data disk to this size |
| `--memory size` | memory size, e.g. 16GiB |
| `-o, --output format` | output format: table or json (default `table`) |
| `--profile string` | network profile |
| `--remove-mount stringArray` | remove the mount at this target directory (repeatable) |
| `--remove-openshell-config stringArray` | remove an OpenShell config directory (repeatable) |
| `--root-disk size` | grow the root disk to this size |

The [global options](brig.md#options) of brig apply too.
